question: What ingredient is put in bread to make it rise?
solution:
The correct answer is **Yeast.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__​**

__
 
• **Yeast** is mostly used in the manufacturing of baked** goods and alcoholic beverages.**
 
• **Yeast** is used to produce fermentation and leavening in the production of food. As they consume **sugars, the fungi release alcohol and carbon dioxide.**
 
• **Yeast cells** range in size from 3 to 5 microns.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 

 
• **Cheese is a dairy product **made from the coagulation of milk protein casein. It comes in a broad variety of flavours, textures, and forms.
 
• The United States, India, and the Russian Federation are close behind China in terms of land area used for **wheat farming.**
 
• Most frequently,** tomato ketchup** is added as a condiment to foods that are frequently served hot, fried, or oily.
